scope.summary: Implement text_kind=path: a StudioTextStory binds to the SAME StudioVectorPath primitive (14.5, no text-only path type) and flows glyphs along it with editable flow-extent handles (start/end), per-section baseline-distance offset, flow-direction control, side-flip, and reverse-path-direction (provenance Affinity path-text handles + baseline control + Reverse Text Path; Photoshop type-on-path/inside-shape; Figma TextPath; Illustrator/InDesign type-on-a-path). Text remains editable while following path geometry; shaping engine re-runs on edit.
acceptance_criteria: text-on-path over shared StudioVectorPath; flow handles/baseline/side-flip/reverse; stays editable
expected_tests: live: glyphs flow along shared StudioVectorPath; start/end handles, baseline offset, side-flip, reverse-direction
test: text stays editable + re-shapes after path edit

target_entries: Studio / Typography / Text on a path

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
